name: Liquid (Gl)ass
tagline: 为 iOS 14–18 的系统界面带来可实时调整的液态玻璃效果。
description: Liquid (Gl)ass 可为 Dock、文件夹、App 资源库、锁屏通知与音乐卡片、快捷操作、时钟、Widget、键盘、标签栏和系统弹窗等界面加入动态玻璃质感。
banana30 同步上游 0.1.1b，进一步改善系统玻璃效果、透明图标、锁屏时钟与多种界面转场。
本项目基于 dylv 的 GPL-3.0 开源版本继续维护，由 dylv & banana 共同署名。
notice: ⚠️ 新包会替换 dylv.liquidass 与 dylv.liquidass.zh-hans，并继承已有设置。修改“移除小组件背景”后请返回插件首页执行“重启系统界面”。开启运动高光可能增加卡顿、发热和耗电。
features: 为多种系统界面提供实时液态玻璃效果
支持经典与增强渲染器手动切换
设置自动保存并实时生效，无需额外 Apply
总开关关闭后完整恢复系统原始样式
iOS 26 风格应用图标，支持透明与统一着色模式
支持调整图标渲染算法、着色色相与着色强度
适配主屏幕、App 资源库、文件夹及动态时钟图标
灵动岛玻璃效果，支持展开、收起与闲置隐藏
支持 iOS 15 浮动式与 iPad 风格 Dock 玻璃效果
优化 iPad Dock 的 App 资源库按钮与转场
全部小组件透明模式，可在移除背景后叠加玻璃效果
小组件背景移除与玻璃亮边独立控制
Widget 与 RWB 独立控制及关闭后的状态恢复
锁屏日期格式开关与 Unicode 格式编辑器
优化锁屏玻璃时钟、日期与解锁转场
提供 Rootless、RootHide 与八种语言本地化
usage: 根据越狱环境安装 Rootless 或 RootHide 软件包；旧版会被自动替换并保留原设置。
打开系统“设置”中的 Liquid (Gl)ass，修改会自动保存并实时生效。
在应用图标设置中选择透明或统一着色模式，并按需调整算法、色相和强度。
在锁屏日期设置中启用、编辑或关闭自定义 Unicode 格式。
修改“移除小组件背景”后，请返回插件首页使用“重启系统界面”。
如出现掉帧或耗电增加，请减少同时启用的组件。

changes: 同步上游 0.1.1b，改善多种系统界面的玻璃效果与解锁转场，并新增经典/增强渲染器切换。
优化透明图标、Dock 图标及锁屏玻璃时钟与日期，修复 iOS 15/18 的显示问题。
优化运动高光与设置滑块性能，增强异常保护与整体稳定性。
全面改进透明图标的层次与玻璃质感，完善文件夹小图标及更多系统图标场景。
新增灵动岛玻璃效果，优化展开、收起、黑底消除、闲置隐藏与亮边状态。
优化 iPad Dock 的 App 资源库按钮和退出动画，并增强小组件与刷新稳定性。
新增“全部小组件透明”模式，并支持独立控制背景移除与玻璃亮边。
修复 iOS 15 小组件透明但缺少玻璃效果，并增强 iOS 15/16 兼容性与重启引导。
优化小组件默认外观与系统界面重启流程，修复锁屏切换和文件夹刷新时的潜在崩溃。
修复部分小组件相关问题。
恢复锁屏日期格式开关与 Unicode 格式编辑器。
支持修改或关闭旧版本遗留的锁屏日期格式。
修复 iOS 17.2.1 等旧系统关闭图标效果后，文件夹预览仍显示原始彩色图标的问题。
增强文件夹预览小图标在布局刷新、缓存更新及视图复用时的效果覆盖。
优化文件夹图标效果同步与原始状态恢复稳定性。
新增 iOS 26 风格应用图标，支持透明、统一着色及算法、色相和强度调整。
新增 iOS 15 浮动式/iPad 风格 Dock，并完善主屏幕、资源库、文件夹和动态时钟图标适配。
修复设置状态、功能冲突和文件夹透明问题，增强多语言及旧系统稳定性。
新增设置自动保存与实时生效，并在总开关关闭后完整恢复系统原始样式。
新增轻量图标高光和 Widget/RWB 独立控制，修复 iOS 18 文件夹玻璃效果消失。
增强 Rootless/RootHide 一致性、旧包迁移、系统界面重载与八语言本地化。
新增重新设计的实时液态玻璃效果。
增强系统界面覆盖、折射、色调、高光与转场表现。
优化空闲性能及关闭插件后的系统材质恢复。

en.name: Liquid (Gl)ass
en.tagline: Live, instantly adjustable liquid-glass styling for system interfaces on iOS 14–18.
description: Liquid (Gl)ass adds dynamic glass styling to the Dock, folders, App Library, Lock Screen notifications and media cards, quick actions, clocks, widgets, keyboards, tab bars, system alerts, and other supported surfaces.
The banana30 build integrates upstream 0.1.1b and further improves system glass effects, transparent icons, the Lock Screen clock, and interface transitions.
This project continues the GPL-3.0 open-source work by dylv and is credited to dylv & banana.
en.notice: ⚠️ This package replaces dylv.liquidass and dylv.liquidass.zh-hans while preserving existing preferences. After changing Remove Widget Background, return to the main page and use Restart System UI. Motion highlights may increase lag, heat, and battery use.
features: Live liquid-glass styling across multiple system surfaces
Manual switching between Classic and Enhanced renderers
Preferences save and apply instantly without a separate Apply action
Full stock-style restoration when the global switch is disabled
iOS 26-style app icons with transparent and unified-tint modes
Adjustable icon rendering algorithm, tint hue, and tint strength
App icon support across the Home Screen, App Library, folders, and dynamic clock
Dynamic Island glass with expansion, collapse, and idle hiding
Floating and iPad-style glass Dock support on iOS 15
Improved iPad Dock App Library button and transitions
All Widgets Transparent mode that layers glass over removed widget backgrounds
Independent widget background removal and glass edge controls
Independent Widget and RWB controls with proper disable restoration
Lock Screen date-format toggle and Unicode format editor
Improved glass Lock Screen clock, date, and unlock transitions
Rootless and RootHide packages with eight-language localization
usage: Install the Rootless or RootHide package matching your jailbreak environment; the previous package is replaced while preferences are preserved.
Open Liquid (Gl)ass in Settings; changes save and apply instantly.
Choose transparent or unified tinting in App Icon settings, then adjust the algorithm, hue, and strength as desired.
Use Lock Screen Date settings to enable, edit, or disable a custom Unicode format.
After changing Remove Widget Background, return to the main page and use Restart System UI.
Reduce the number of enabled surfaces if animation smoothness or battery life is affected.

changes: Integrated upstream 0.1.1b improvements across system glass surfaces and unlock transitions, and added Classic/Enhanced renderer switching.
Improved transparent and Dock icons plus the glass Lock Screen clock and date, fixing display issues on iOS 15 and iOS 18.
Optimized motion highlights and Settings slider performance, with stronger failure protection and overall stability.
Improved transparent icon depth and glass styling across folder previews and more system icon surfaces.
Added Dynamic Island glass with refined expansion, collapse, black-background removal, idle hiding, and edge highlights.
Improved the iPad Dock App Library button and exit transition, plus widget and refresh stability.
Added All Widgets Transparent mode with independent widget background removal and glass edge controls.
Fixed transparent widgets missing the glass effect on iOS 15 and improved iOS 15/16 compatibility and restart guidance.
Improved default widget appearance and the Restart System UI flow, and fixed potential crashes during Lock Screen transitions and folder refreshes.
Fixed several widget-related issues.
Restored the Lock Screen date-format toggle and Unicode format editor.
Added support for editing or disabling Lock Screen date formats left by previous versions.
Fixed folder previews retaining original colored icons after disabling icon effects on older releases such as iOS 17.2.1.
Improved effect coverage for folder preview icons during layout refreshes, cache updates, and view reuse.
Improved folder icon effect synchronization and stock-state restoration stability.
Added iOS 26-style app icons with transparent and unified tinting plus algorithm, hue, and strength controls.
Added floating and iPad-style Dock glass on iOS 15 and improved Home Screen, App Library, folder, and dynamic-clock icon support.
Fixed preference state, feature conflicts, and folder transparency, and improved localization and legacy-system stability.
Added automatic live preference updates and full stock-style restoration when the global switch is disabled.
Added lightweight Icon Highlights and independent Widget/RWB controls, and fixed disappearing folder glass on iOS 18.
Improved Rootless/RootHide consistency, legacy-package migration, interface reloads, and eight-language localization.
Added redesigned real-time liquid-glass styling.
Expanded system-surface coverage and improved refraction, tint, highlights, and transitions.
Optimized idle performance and stock-material restoration after disabling the tweak.
